integrity: Claims have a complete analytic facet-inequality and cyclic-incidence proof and a reproducible standard-library checker. Mathematical literature comparisons and status are not an independent scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: The full general classification is confined to right regular bipyramids with equal pole heights; the unequal-height result concerns one explicit pentagonal example. Historical priority remains provisional. The finite verifier is corroborative, not a proof for all real heights or all integers n.
title: Illumination rigidity of right regular bipyramids and an asymmetric counterexample
